title: Describe it
about: Every file in this film is quoted from docs/manual/captures as it stood on examples/plugged-in while recording, and every line of terminal output is replayed from the same recordings, made by running the commands for real.

lines.text: The plan page is agreed, as far as it goes. It names a wallet. It still has doubts on it.
Now the page becomes a blueprint. And what you haven't decided must not get decided on the way.
The designer doesn't start from an empty file. It runs ortho add thing, wallet. Then ortho add operation, wallet.open.
lines.say: The designer doesn't start from an empty file. It runs ortho add thing, wallet. Then ortho add operation, wallet dot open.

lines.text: The framework writes the frame. Seven files for the thing, one for the operation.
None of them holds a decision. Where a decision goes, there is a blank, and the blank says what is missing.
Now run ortho check.
The wallet has seven blanks. Each one is a line: a file, a line number, and the question.
What a wallet is. Its states. Who holds a role on it. And four about opening one.
The model says it shorter. The wallet is listed with no states, and two lines say what is unfinished.
Two of the seven are already answered on the plan page. So the designer fills those two, in the page's words.
What a wallet is: a handle's money, one for each claimed handle.
And its states: opening, open, frozen, closed.
Check again. Five blanks.
The designer stops there. Who may open a wallet depends on a question you haven't answered. So it stays a blank.
The check has a second complaint. Drift, eight files. The blueprint changed, so what was made from it is stale.
So run ortho generate. It doesn't wait for the blanks.
lines.say: So run Ortho generate. It doesn't wait for the blanks.

lines.text: The wallet gets its types, its page of docs and its table. The unfinished operation is left out, and no handler is written for it.
Check again. Types pass. Rules pass. Drift passes. And check still fails, on five blanks. That is right.
You read two changed lines, and a list of questions. The count should go down only when you decide something.
Generate too early, and it goes wrong. With the states still blank, generate wrote a types file that doesn't compile, and check said so.
And the check can't tell a decision from a guess. When the count drops, ask which line of the plan each answer came from.
One honest note. The recording filled those two blanks itself, in the plan's words. No agent was filmed designing. And leaving blanks is our practice. Nothing enforces it yet.
Next: say what done means.

pictures.carries: The count of blanks, drawn as the check's own list of questions with its number above it: seven, then five, computed from describe-0-check.txt, describe-1-check.txt and describe-2-check.txt. It returns on every sheet after the first.
pictures.declare: The designer acts. A terminal replays describe-add-thing.txt and describe-add-operation.txt; beside it an editor quotes describe-0-open.ts.txt, its four Blueprint.todo lines marked as blanks.
pictures.blanks: A terminal replays describe-0-check.txt down to its seventh blank, each line becoming one row of the list of questions under the number seven; the lower third replays the wallet's line and the two unfinished lines of describe-0-model.txt.
pictures.fill: The designer acts. An editor shows describe-0-thing.ts.txt becoming describe-1-thing.ts.txt, then describe-0-machine.ts.txt becoming describe-1-machine.ts.txt, beside the Wallet line of plan-page.txt; two rows leave the list as describe-1-check.txt replays and the number becomes five.
pictures.generate: A terminal replays the drift lines of describe-1-check.txt, then describe-2-generate.txt, then describe-2-check.txt, with describe-2-handlers.txt showing no wallet folder under src; the list of five questions stays beside it, and only the final verdict is red.
pictures.read: You act. The list of five questions stands alone; then a terminal replays the types lines of describe-early-check.txt over line nine of describe-early-types.ts.txt; Kit.stand marks add, check, model and generate as running today, the designer leaving blanks as practice, and a second kind of blank and the ready check as missing.
